have h : List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l₁ l₂ t := by induction t <;> refine ⟨?b, F _ _ _ ?b⟩ <;> constructor <;> first | exact ‹_ ∧ _›.1 | exact ‹_ ∧ _›.2

have h : List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l₁ l₂ t := by induction t with | slnil => exact ⟨.slnil, F _ _ _ .slnil⟩ | cons a h ih => exact ⟨.cons a h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (.cons a h ih.1 ih.2)⟩ | cons₂ a h ih => exact ⟨.cons₂ a h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (.cons₂ a h ih.1 ih.2)⟩
have h : List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l₁ l₂ t := by induction t <;> refine ⟨?b, F _ _ _ ?b⟩ <;> constructor <;> grind
have h : List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l₁ l₂ t := by induction t <;> constructor <;> (try apply F) <;> constructor <;> simp_all
